scope.title: EvidencePack - Scope Only
scope.summary: Provide the 'scope' object for an EvidencePack JSON per the EvidencePack schema; other top-level fields omitted or left to the requester.
objectives: Produce a scope object that clearly defines what is included and excluded from the EvidencePack.
Ensure the scope JSON is self-contained, valid JSON, and conforms to the EvidencePack schema's expectations for the scope field.
in_scope: Definition of deliverables and evidence types to be collected (documents, reports, datasets).
Timeframe for evidence collection and review.
Primary stakeholders and point(s) of contact.
Acceptance criteria and success metrics for the evidence pack.
Constraints, assumptions, and dependencies relevant to evidence collection.
Any required compliance or confidentiality restrictions.
out_of_scope: Collection, upload, or validation of individual evidence items beyond listing types.
Detailed analysis or synthesis of evidence.
Final sign-off or archival processes unless explicitly requested.
deliverables: A single JSON object named 'scope' populated as provided.
A concise list of in-scope evidence types and exclusions.
Acceptance criteria for the completed EvidencePack.

timeline.duration: to be defined by requester; default: 7 calendar days for full EvidencePack completion after scope approval

stakeholders.description: User who requested the EvidencePack scope
Person responsible for producing and validating the EvidencePack (assistant)

assumptions: Requester will confirm or modify the scope as needed.
EvidencePack schema's 'scope' field accepts keys used here (title, summary, objectives, in_scope, out_of_scope, deliverables, timeline, stakeholders, assumptions, constraints, acceptance_criteria).
Any uploaded source documents that are relevant will be provided separately for evidence collection.
constraints: Response must be valid JSON and contain only the scope object at top-level per requester instruction.
Other EvidencePack fields will be omitted unless explicitly requested.
acceptance_criteria: JSON output includes a top-level 'scope' object.
Scope object clearly lists in-scope and out-of-scope items and at least one acceptance criterion.
Requester confirms the scope or requests edits.
scope.notes: Scope prepared; ready for requester review and revision. Source files available for later evidence collection:
